title: Sweet Pudding Kheer
description: A creamy Indian dessert made with sweetened condensed milk, pudding, and a hint of yeasty flavor.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the sweetened condensed milk, pudding, and milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in a pinch of yeast for a yeasty flavor.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours.
Serve cold, garnished with a sprinkle of cardamom powder if desired.
